title: It Really Needs More Suction Power
text:
It Really Needs More Suction Power. First, to the Livion Company, please do not write a reply to my review stating that I would get more suction power out of the vacuum if I use the batteries instead of the USB cable. I never even unwrapped the USB cable. I immediately put in 4 AA batteries that I assure you have full power, as I have a high quality battery tester and I test all batteries before I use them, even fresh ones out of a sealed package.

I realize that this vacuum is only $20, but still I expected/hoped for more suction power. It makes noise like it should have decent suction power, but it does not.

Also, the way it feels in the hand is not as comfortable as I would like. It it quite wide in the rear. Perhaps it could use a handle, etc. But I could absolutely live with its awkward/uncomfy shape if the suction power was better.
